h1: Red Notice ratings: reading the IMDb and critic-score gap
description: {{title}} sits at {{imdb}} on IMDb but {{rt}} on Rotten Tomatoes; see what the audience-versus-critic difference suggests and who it suits.
summary: Red Notice has IMDb {{imdb}} and Rotten Tomatoes {{rt}} in this snapshot. Audiences score sharply higher than critics in the site's arithmetic comparison, a wide gap of {{gapAbs}} points. IMDb averages viewer ratings; the Tomatometer counts positive critic reviews, so their distance cannot measure the reasons for that response. The source is OMDb as of {{asOf}}.

sections.heading: What does the Red Notice critic and audience gap show?
paragraphs: IMDb's audience average converts to {{imdbX10}} when multiplied by ten, against a Tomatometer of {{rt}}. Audiences score sharply higher than critics on that arithmetic comparison, with a wide gap of {{gapAbs}} points. The distance ranks {{gapRank}} among {{setSize}} films in this dataset, ordered by absolute difference.

The Metascore is {{metascore}}, numerically close to the Rotten Tomatoes percentage. That is a second low critic aggregate in this snapshot, although Metacritic averages weighted grades and the Tomatometer counts approving reviews. Their proximity suggests that looking at another critic measure does not remove the contrast; it does not identify which creative choices drew the response.

Among the {{genreCount}} {{genre}} films in this set, the median difference is {{genreMedianGap}}. Red Notice therefore follows the genre's median direction but with a larger numerical distance. That comparison describes these selected popular films, rather than all action films or all viewers.

The [comparison of IMDb and Rotten Tomatoes](/compare/imdb-vs-rotten-tomatoes) explains the measurement mismatch. A middling viewer average and a low positive-review percentage can coexist without either database being wrong. Neither number supplies a cause for the reaction or a prediction of your own enjoyment.

paragraphs: A lawman chasing a famed thief ends up working beside a competing crook, and trust between them stays shaky. {{director}} directed and wrote it, with Dwayne Johnson, Ryan Reynolds and Gal Gadot listed as lead cast. The source record lists action, comedy and thriller as genres, and the United States and Italy as countries. These describe the database entry; the chart ranking does not verify any additional production facts.

sections.heading: How can Red Notice scores help with your choice?
paragraphs: If your selection habit gives more weight to viewer averages, IMDb's {{imdb}} is the relevant starting point. If you normally follow critical reception, the Tomatometer of {{rt}} and Metascore of {{metascore}} give a different set of signals. Read them according to their definitions rather than averaging them into a new grade.

For anyone considering an action comedy, the cast, genre and listed duration of {{runtime}} may help decide whether to investigate further. Individual reviews can explain what their authors valued; the aggregate table cannot. A viewer who prefers the audience measure can still inspect the critic objections before choosing, without assuming that every participant shares the same reason for a vote.

sections.heading: Does the Red Notice vote total settle the disagreement?
paragraphs: The source snapshot lists {{votes}} IMDb votes. That establishes how many ratings the returned count records, without showing whether the voters represent everyone who watched. Netflix hours come from a different measurement system, so a high popularity rank cannot establish the tastes or demographics of the IMDb participants.

OMDb's awards field reads 2 nominations total. This page makes no claim about the completeness of that field or a connection between nominations and reception. The scores, vote count and chart record remain separate evidence, and fresh lookups may differ from the dated values shown here.

faq.q: Why does Red Notice score so differently on IMDb and Rotten Tomatoes?
faq.a: The IMDb average of {{imdb}} becomes {{imdbX10}} on the arithmetic scale here, while Rotten Tomatoes reports {{rt}} positive critic reviews. The resulting {{gapAbs}} points put audiences sharply higher numerically. Different populations and calculations contribute different signals; these aggregates do not establish why individual reviewers or voters reacted as they did.

faq.q: Does Red Notice have any awards listed on OMDb?
faq.a: The OMDb awards field reads 2 nominations total. That is a dated database string rather than a complete verified awards history. It does not explain the critic percentage or audience average, so this page treats the nominations field separately from the rating comparison.

faq.q: How long did Red Notice stay in Netflix's Top 10?
faq.a: The Netflix snapshot records {{weeksInTop10}} global Top 10 weeks and a peak rank of {{peakRank}}. Its {{hours}} viewing hours from the Most Popular list's initial release window place it {{popularityRank}} in this selected set. Those totals describe popularity under the stated method, not unique people, completed watches or favorable reviews.
